# Rapportraketer och AI-rysare – Olavi om avgiftskritiken

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN), 15 Oct 2026, with guest Jonas Olavi. The first part responds to social-media criticism of Alpcot's fees; the second part covers Q3 reports and an AI-stock selloff driven by CoreWeave's bond-market trouble and debt worries at Oracle. Olavi praises Ericsson's earnings beat but won't buy it, is negative on Nordea after it paused buybacks, and has no interest in real estate or Kinnevik. He says the AI pullback is just nerves and the business underneath is still strong, and rates ASML, TSMC and Nvidia a top 'ten' (buy).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Olavi calls ASML a buy and rates it 10. It is getting inquiries for 2030, and long contracts reduce cyclicality.

#### Reasoning

Guest Jonas Olavi sees the AI selloff as nerves, not a change in fundamentals. ASML getting inquiries out to 2030 shows long demand visibility, and long contracts dampen cyclicality. He expects a real slowdown only several years ahead and prefers dominant companies with pricing power.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake or long-dated inquiries weaken
- if the AI capex cycle slows sharply earlier than expected

> *"ASML? Det är köp. Köp 10, eller? En tia, då."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Strong report and raised Q4 guidance. Capex grows only with orders. Olavi rates it 10.

#### Reasoning

TSMC raised Q4 guidance well above expectations. The small margin dip comes from ramping 2nm and expanding capacity in Taiwan and Arizona, and management only invests in step with orders. Olavi says demand will not be saturated for many years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if guidance is cut or demand shows saturation
- if margin pressure from the 2nm ramp persists beyond expectations

> *"TSMC, Nvidia? Ja, tia."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Rated 10 together with TSMC. Olavi backs Jensen Huang's view that AI build-out will continue.

#### Reasoning

Olavi agrees with Huang's 'five-layer cake' thesis. He sees the AI selloff (CoreWeave, Oracle debt) as nerves unrelated to the underlying business, and favours dominant players with pricing power while warning against putting everything in one stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI infrastructure spending slows materially
- if credit stress among AI customers such as CoreWeave spreads to demand

> *"TSMC, Nvidia? Ja, tia."*

---

### 🟠 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong quarter and the stock is up 10%, but Olavi won't buy: flat market, margin pressure, and a 3-year return in line with the world index.

#### Reasoning

Olavi likes the company and gives the new CEO time and a thumbs up. But the core market barely grows, component shortages and input costs will squeeze margins, and he doubts next year's forecasts will rise. His models say it won't beat the world index, so he needs more before buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin pressure from component costs is severe
- if Narvinger fails to find new growth or makes poor acquisitions

> *"Nej, jag gör inte det. ... Jag gillar Ericsson, jag tycker det är ett fantastiskt bolag. ... Men det måste lite mer till för att jag ska köpa den."*

---

### ⛔ NDA-SE — Nordea | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Buybacks paused after capital-model talks with the ECB. Risk exposure amounts may rise, and the dividend could be threatened.

#### Reasoning

Olavi calls it the same story as SEB. The report was close to expectations, but higher risk exposure amounts reduce room for buybacks and could threaten the dividend in a worse case, which erodes its appeal as a yield stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulators clarify capital models without raising risk exposure amounts
- if buybacks resume

> *"Då blir det här med att det är avkastningsaktier, det naggas i kanten. Det naggas i kanten rejält på börsen."*

---

### ⛔ KINV-B — Kinnevik | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Olavi rates his interest 0–1. Complicated portfolio built when rates were low, no cash cow, and Q3 NAV growth was weak.

#### Reasoning

The portfolio was shifted toward disruptive investments when rates were near zero. Now that rates are higher, Kinnevik no longer has the telecom cash flows it used to reinvest. Q3 NAV growth of 1% was well below expectations (Pareto), and the stock is down 10%. Olavi: 'we skip Kinnevik'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new CEO's concentrated European strategy produces NAV growth
- if the portfolio is restructured into cash-generating assets

> *"Vi struntar i Kinnevik, tycker jag."*

---

### ⛔ WALL-B — Wallenstam | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Olavi rates his interest in the property sector 0 (Wallenstam, Entra, SLP, Emilshus all reporting).

#### Reasoning

This is a sector-level 0/10 interest rating from the guest, not a company-specific case. It signals no appetite for Swedish real estate right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the guest's sector view turns positive

> *"Fastigheter 0, Kinnevik 0–1, tolkar jag det som."*
